create_bulk_from_atoms: create a Bulk object by passing an ase.Atoms object directly to the constructor
create_bulk_from_db_index: create a Bulk object by selecting a specific index from the bulk database pickle file
create_bulk_from_src_id: create a Bulk object by looking up a source ID like mp-30 in the bulk database
sample_random_bulk: sample a random bulk structure from the bulk database by calling Bulk with no arguments
get_slabs_from_bulk: get all possible slab surfaces from a Bulk object using get_slabs with a max Miller index
